prompt:
Portrait 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook-animation, luxury outdoor mountain-to-beach wedding. Preserve adult Indian faces, medium-brown skin and natural proportions. DRAMATIC LIGHT: diagonal volumetric sunshafts through waterfall or sea mist, deep sculpted shade, bright fabric rim light, moving caustic reflections; at night cyan moonbeams balance amber practical pools. Modern coastal typography: elegant editorial serif with restrained handwritten accents, pearl-white headlines, deep ocean-teal body copy, brushed-platinum edges, fine cyan glow; no ornate antique lettering. Distinct natural locations, expensive site-specific decor. Cars are parked, wheels fixed; everyone has planted feet. Only camera, environment and subtle gestures move. Tiny mist beads, windborne grass seeds or coastal bubbles hang at varied depths, never a confetti storm. Text-only image, no watermark or extra words.

SCENE COMPOSITION:
Eye-level view at a distinct grassy waterfall-side overlook across the pool, reached by following the visible curved riverside trail. ONE ivory invitation card rests upright in a split natural rock on the lower right, filling about 55 percent of frame width, generous margins and sage botanical border. Exact luminous lettering: 'Sounder & Mohan
Family
Wedding Invitation'. Pearl-white editorial heading over deep-teal modern serif body copy; fine platinum highlights. The waterfall is seen diagonally from its side, offset far LEFT, with wet cliff strata and open sky. A thin trail curves behind the rock toward a higher mountain road; the sage car is a tiny distant travel clue there. Uneven grass and a low wildflower patch occupy the opposite foreground; no matching frame on both sides. Warm sunlight catches the card edges and spray. No earlier stage in this new view, no repeated platform or identical composition. The invitation is physically steady, with a few fine water droplets in the background, never rain across the lettering.
